<br>
The '''Afreeca Starleague Season 6: Wild Card Qualifier''' is the tournament held on August 14, 2018 to determine the seed for the [[Afreeca Starleague Season 6]].

Initially, [[Rain]], the winner of [[Afreeca Starleague Season 5|ASL Season 5]], had to be joined by fellow top-four finishers [[Snow]], [[hero]] and [[Mini]] in the round of 16 in Season 6. hero, who has recently enlisted in the military to fulfill his mandatory military service, could not participate and his slot will be determined by a wild card match between 5th-8th finishers of the Season 5. [[Larva (Player)|Larva]] withdrew from the Wildcard qualifier thus leaving only three contenders for the spot.
</noinclude>
